integrity: The infinite claim follows from an explicit matrix-lifting isometry proof. A standard-library verifier checks exact modular identities, finite isometry samples, and root lifts through 2^20. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact valuation formula is proved only for n=1280+1792t, t>=0, the exceptional progression in the earlier partial Tripell 2-adic classification. The root is characterized in Z_2 by uniqueness and compatible residues; no elementary closed form or classification for other progressions is claimed.
title: Exact 2-adic valuation on the exceptional Tripell progression
